name: @splicewire/beam-ux-canvas
description: Optional VFX decoration layer for beam surfaces — effects decorate, they never replace: every effect wraps real, shippable DOM (the real component tree is always present, focusable, and accessible underneath). Ships ParticleObject, a Three.js GPU point cloud sampled from a source image with cursor scatter + spring-damper return, gated behind WebGL-capability and prefers-reduced-motion detection. Promoted out of splicewire-app's app-local beam-ux-canvas prototype (ui/src/_prototype/beam-ux-canvas).
